title: Invite a new agent
aliases: send an invite to a new team member
body:
Only admins can invite agents.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Select **Invite agent**.
3. Enter the agent's name and work email address.
4. Choose a **Role**, then select a **Team** if you want to add them straight away.
5. Select **Send invite**.

The invite link expires after 7 days. You can resend it from the agent's row.

title: Update an agent's phone number
aliases: fix phone number on agent profile
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Select the agent's name to open their profile.
3. Select **Edit profile**.
4. Enter the new number in the **Phone** field.
5. Select **Save changes**.

Agents can also update their own number from **My profile**.

title: Change an agent's email address
aliases: edit the login email for an agent
body:
Changing the email also changes the address the agent uses to sign in.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Open the agent's profile.
3. Select **Edit profile**.
4. Replace the address in the **Email** field.
5. Select **Save changes**.
6. Ask the agent to confirm the new address using the link we send.

title: Deactivate an agent
body:
Deactivating an agent stops them signing in but keeps their ticket history.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Select the agent's name.
3. Select **More actions** > **Deactivate agent**.
4. Choose who should receive their open tickets.
5. Select **Deactivate**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Reactivate a deactivated agent
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Select the **Deactivated** filter.
3. Open the agent's profile.
4. Select **More actions** > **Reactivate agent**.
5. Confirm their **Role** and **Team**, then select **Reactivate**.

The agent will receive an email asking them to set a new password.

title: Create a team
aliases: set up a new support team
start a team for billing queries
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select **New team**.
3. Enter a **Team name** and an optional description.
4. Choose the agents to include.
5. Select **Create team**.

Teams can be used as assignment targets in routing rules and reports.

title: Add an agent to a team
aliases: put an agent in a team
add a member to a team
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select the team's name.
3. Select **Add members**.
4. Tick the agents you want to add.
5. Select **Add to team**.

An agent can belong to more than one team.

title: Remove an agent from a team
aliases: take someone out of a team
kick an agent out of a group
agent no longer on this team
body:
Removing an agent from a team does not deactivate their account.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select the team's name.
3. Find the agent in the **Members** list.
4. Select **Remove** next to their name.
5. Select **Confirm**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Rename a team
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select the team you want to rename.
3. Select **Edit team**.
4. Type the new name in **Team name**.
5. Select **Save changes**.

Existing routing rules and reports will pick up the new name automatically.

title: Delete a team
body:
Deleting a team does not delete its agents or their tickets.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select the team's name.
3. Select **More actions** > **Delete team**.
4. Choose a team to receive any tickets still assigned to this one.
5. Select **Delete team**.

title: Change an agent's role
body:
Roles control what an agent can see and change. The built-in roles are **Agent**, **Supervisor** and **Admin**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Open the agent's profile.
3. Select **Edit profile**.
4. Pick a new option from the **Role** list.
5. Select **Save changes**.

title: Create a custom role
aliases: build a role with limited access
body:
1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Roles**.
2. Select **New role**.
3. Name the role, for example **Billing specialist**.
4. Switch on the permissions this role needs, such as **View reports** or **Edit knowledge base**.
5. Select **Save role**.

You can then choose the new role when you invite or edit an agent.

title: Set your availability status
body:
Your status decides whether new tickets and chats can be assigned to you.

1. Select your profile picture at the top right.
2. Select the current status, such as **Available**.
3. Choose **Away**, **Busy** or **Offline**.
4. Optionally add a note, such as "Back at 2pm".

Select **Available** again when you return.

title: Add an email signature to your profile
aliases: sign off replies with my name
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Select your profile picture, then **My profile**.
2. Open the **Signature** tab.
3. Type your signature in the editor. You can use bold text and line breaks.
4. Select **Save**.

Your signature is added to email replies you send from the **Inbox**.

title: Set a maximum number of open tickets for an agent
aliases: stop an agent getting too many tickets
body:
Once an agent reaches the limit, automatic assignment skips them.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Open the agent's profile.
3. Select **Workload**.
4. Enter a number in **Maximum open tickets**.
5. Select **Save changes**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Export your agent list to CSV
aliases: download all agents as a spreadsheet
get a list of agents in Excel
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Use the filters if you only need some agents, for example a **Team**.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV** and select **Download**.

The file includes name, email, phone, role, team and status.

title: Add an internal note to an agent's profile
aliases: leave a note about an agent
write a note on a team member
record training notes for an agent
add a comment to agent record
body:
Notes on a profile are visible to admins and supervisors only.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Agents**.
2. Open the agent's profile.
3. Select the **Notes** tab.
4. Type your note in the box.
5. Select **Add note**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Create an SLA policy
aliases: set up a service level agreement
make an SLA for premium customers
body:
An SLA policy sets the time targets your team works to.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs**.
2. Select **New SLA policy**.
3. Enter a **Policy name**.
4. Under **Applies to**, add conditions such as **Customer plan** is **Premium**.
5. Set your targets, then select **Save policy**.

title: Edit an SLA policy
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs**.
2. Select the policy name.
3. Change the conditions or targets.
4. Select **Save policy**.

Changes apply to new tickets. Tickets already open keep their original targets unless you select **Apply to open tickets**.

title: Delete an SLA policy
aliases: get rid of a service level policy
body:
Tickets that used the policy keep their breach history in reports.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs**.
2. Select the **More** menu on the policy's row.
3. Select **Delete**.
4. Select **Confirm**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Duplicate an SLA policy
aliases: make a copy of an existing SLA
reuse an SLA as a template
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs**.
2. Select the **More** menu on the policy you want to copy.
3. Select **Duplicate**.
4. Rename the copy and adjust its conditions.
5. Select **Save policy**.

The copy is created switched off until you turn it on.

title: Set a first response target
aliases: how fast should we first reply
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs** and open a policy.
2. Find the **First response time** section.
3. Enter a time for each priority: **Low**, **Normal**, **High** and **Urgent**.
4. Choose **Business hours** or **Calendar hours**.
5. Select **Save policy**.

title: Set a resolution target
aliases: how long to solve a ticket
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs** and open a policy.
2. Find the **Resolution time** section.
3. Enter a target time for each priority.
4. Select **Business hours** or **Calendar hours** under **Count time by**.
5. Select **Save policy**.

title: Use different SLA targets for each priority
aliases: set shorter targets for urgent tickets
body:
A single policy can hold a separate target for every priority level.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs** and open a policy.
2. Select **Different targets per priority**.
3. Enter first response and resolution times for **Low**, **Normal**, **High** and **Urgent**.
4. Select **Save policy**.

title: Create a business hours schedule
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select **New schedule**.
3. Name the schedule, for example **Sydney weekdays**.
4. Choose a **Time zone**.
5. Set opening and closing times for each day, then select **Save schedule**.

title: Edit business hours
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select the schedule you want to change.
3. Adjust the times for the days affected, or switch a day off with the **Open** toggle.
4. Select **Save schedule**.

SLA clocks use the new hours straight away.

title: Change the time zone of a schedule
aliases: wrong time zone on business hours
switch schedule to another time zone
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select the schedule.
3. Open the **Time zone** list and choose the correct one.
4. Select **Save schedule**.

Opening times stay the same in the new time zone, so check them after you save.

title: Add a holiday to a schedule
aliases: mark a public holiday as closed
body:
Tickets received on a holiday do not count against SLA targets.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select the schedule.
3. Open the **Holidays** tab and select **Add holiday**.
4. Enter a name and choose the date or date range.
5. Select **Save**.

title: Delete a holiday from a schedule
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select the schedule and open the **Holidays** tab.
3. Select the **Delete** icon next to the holiday.
4. Select **Confirm**.

Changes are saved straight away.

title: Assign a business hours schedule to a team
aliases: use different hours for a team
apply opening hours to a team
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **People** > **Teams**.
2. Select the team's name.
3. Select **Edit team**.
4. Choose a schedule from the **Business hours** list.
5. Select **Save changes**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Pause the SLA clock while waiting for the customer
body:
When a ticket is set to **Pending**, you can stop the clock so waiting time is not counted against your team.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs**.
2. Select **Settings**.
3. Switch on **Pause SLA when status is Pending**.
4. Select **Save**.

The clock restarts when the customer replies.

title: Send an alert before an SLA is breached
aliases: warn me about tickets about to breach
body:
1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **SLAs** and open a policy.
2. Select **Alerts**.
3. Choose how long before the target the alert is sent, for example **30 minutes**.
4. Pick who to notify: the **Assignee**, the **Team supervisor** or both.
5. Select **Save policy**.

title: See tickets at risk of breaching their SLA
aliases: which tickets are about to be late
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Inbox**.
2. Select the **Views** menu.
3. Choose **At risk of SLA breach**.
4. Sort by **Time remaining** to see the most urgent first.

Breached tickets appear in red. Changes are saved straight away.

title: Export your holiday list to CSV
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Service levels** > **Business hours**.
2. Select the schedule and open the **Holidays** tab.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Select **Download CSV**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**. Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Create a knowledge base article
aliases: add an article to the knowledge base
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Select **New article**.
3. Enter a **Title** and write the content in the editor.
4. Choose a **Category**.
5. Select **Save draft** to keep it private, or **Publish** to make it live.

title: Edit a knowledge base article
aliases: fix a typo in an article
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Search for the article or browse to its category.
3. Select the article, then **Edit**.
4. Make your changes in the editor.
5. Select **Save**.

Published articles update straight away. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Delete a knowledge base article
aliases: take down an article for good
body:
Deleted articles can be restored from the **Trash** for 30 days. To hide an article without deleting it, unpublish it instead.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Open the article.
3. Select **More actions** > **Delete**.
4. Select **Move to Trash**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Publish a draft article
aliases: go live with a help article
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** and select the **Drafts** tab.
2. Open the article.
3. Check the content and **Category**.
4. Select **Publish**.

Customers can find the article in the help centre straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Unpublish an article
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Open the published article.
3. Select **More actions** > **Unpublish**.
4. Select **Confirm**.

The article moves back to **Drafts**, and keeps its content and history. Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Schedule an article to publish later
aliases: publish an article at a set time
set a go-live date for an article
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** and open a draft.
2. Select the arrow next to **Publish**.
3. Choose **Schedule**.
4. Pick a date and time.
5. Select **Schedule article**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Create a knowledge base category
aliases: set up a folder for articles
make a new help topic section
add a section to the help centre
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** > **Categories**.
2. Select **New category**.
3. Enter a **Name** and a short description.
4. Select **Save**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Rename a knowledge base category
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** > **Categories**.
2. Select **Edit** next to the category.
3. Type the new **Name**.
4. Select **Save**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**. Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Delete a knowledge base category
aliases: get rid of a help section
body:
A category must be empty before it can be deleted.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** > **Categories**.
2. Move or delete any articles inside it.
3. Select **More** next to the category.
4. Select **Delete category**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Move an article to another category
aliases: put article in a different folder
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Open the article.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Choose a new option from the **Category** list.
5. Select **Save**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role. Changes are saved straight away.

title: Add an image to an article
aliases: insert a screenshot into a help article
upload a picture to an article
put a photo in the knowledge base
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Open the article and select **Edit**.
2. Place the cursor where you want the image.
3. Select **Insert** > **Image**.
4. Upload a file from your computer. Images up to 5 MB are supported.
5. Add **Alt text**, then select **Save**.

title: Make an article visible to agents only
aliases: hide article from customers but keep it for staff
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** and open the article.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Open the **Visibility** list.
4. Choose **Agents only**.
5. Select **Save**.

Agents can still find it when replying to tickets. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Restore a previous version of an article
aliases: go back to an earlier version
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** and open the article.
2. Select **History**.
3. Choose the version you want from the list.
4. Select **Restore this version**.
5. Select **Confirm**.

Restoring creates a new version, so no history is lost.

title: Add a translation to an article
aliases: make an article available in another language
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Knowledge base** and open the article.
2. Select **Translations**.
3. Select **Add translation** and choose a language.
4. Enter the translated title and content.
5. Select **Publish translation**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Add an internal note to an article
aliases: leave a comment on an article
write a reminder on a help article
body:
Notes are only visible to agents with permission to edit the knowledge base.

1. Open the article in **Knowledge base**.
2. Select **Notes** in the side panel.
3. Type your note.
4. Select **Add note**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Export knowledge base articles to CSV
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Knowledge base**.
2. Use the **Category** and **Status** filters if you only need some articles.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV** and select **Download**.

The file lists titles, categories, status and last updated date. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Insert a knowledge base article into a reply
aliases: send a help article to a customer
link an article in my response
share an FAQ in a ticket reply
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Open the ticket in your **Inbox**.
2. Select **Reply**.
3. Select the **Articles** icon in the editor toolbar.
4. Search for the article and select **Insert link**.
5. Select **Send**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Add the chat widget to your website
aliases: put the chat button on my site
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat**.
2. Select **Widget**, then **Install**.
3. Copy the code snippet.
4. Paste it just before the closing body tag on every page where you want chat to appear.
5. Select **Verify installation**.

title: Change the chat widget colour
aliases: change the colour of live chat
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Appearance**.
3. Enter a hex code in **Accent colour**, or choose from the picker.
4. Select **Save**.

The preview on the right shows how the widget will look.

title: Edit the chat welcome message
aliases: set what customers see when chat opens
write an opening message for live chat
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Messages**.
3. Edit the text in **Welcome message**.
4. Select **Save**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**. Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Show an offline message when no agents are available
aliases: what customers see after hours in chat
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Messages**.
3. Edit the text in **Offline message**.
4. Switch on **Let visitors leave a message** if you want to collect an email address.
5. Select **Save**.

Messages left offline become tickets.

title: Set up a pre-chat form
aliases: ask for name and email before chat
collect details before starting a chat
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Pre-chat form**.
3. Switch on the fields you want to ask for, such as **Name**, **Email** and **Topic**.
4. Mark any field as **Required**.
5. Select **Save**.

title: Transfer a chat to another agent or team
aliases: pass a live chat to someone else
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Open the chat from your **Inbox**.
2. Select **Transfer**.
3. Choose an **Agent** or a **Team**.
4. Add a short note explaining the context.
5. Select **Transfer chat**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: End a live chat
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Open the chat from your **Inbox**.
2. Select **End chat**.
3. Select **End chat** again to confirm.

The customer sees a message that the chat has finished, and the conversation stays in the ticket history. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Send a chat transcript to a customer
aliases: email a copy of the chat
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Open the finished chat from your **Inbox**.
2. Select **More actions** > **Send transcript**.
3. Check the customer's email address.
4. Select **Send**.

You can also switch on **Send transcript automatically** in the live chat settings.

title: Create a saved reply for chat
aliases: add a shortcut for common answers
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Saved replies**.
2. Select **New saved reply**.
3. Enter a **Shortcut**, such as /refund.
4. Type the message text.
5. Select **Save**.

Agents type the shortcut in a chat to insert the message.

title: Delete a saved reply
aliases: get rid of a quick reply
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Saved replies**.
2. Find the reply using the search box.
3. Select the **Delete** icon.
4. Select **Confirm**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Block a chat visitor
aliases: prevent a person from starting chats
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Open the chat with the visitor.
2. Select **More actions** > **Block visitor**.
3. Choose **Block by email** or **Block by IP address**.
4. Select **Block**.

To undo this, go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Blocked visitors** and select **Unblock**.

title: Set how many chats an agent can handle at once
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Routing**.
2. Enter a number in **Maximum concurrent chats**.
3. Select **Save**.

Agents at their limit will not be offered new chats until one ends.

title: Convert a chat into a ticket
aliases: turn a chat into a ticket
follow up on a chat later by email
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Open the chat from your **Inbox**.
2. Select **More actions** > **Convert to ticket**.
3. Set the **Priority** and **Assignee**.
4. Select **Create ticket**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role. Changes are saved straight away.

title: Allow customers to send files in chat
aliases: let customers upload attachments in chat
turn on file sharing in live chat
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Features**.
3. Switch on **File uploads**.
4. Choose the maximum file size.
5. Select **Save**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Turn on desktop notifications for new chats
aliases: get a sound when a chat arrives
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Select your profile picture, then **My profile**.
2. Open the **Notifications** tab.
3. Switch on **New chat** under **Desktop**.
4. Allow notifications when your browser asks.

You can choose a sound in the same section. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Ask customers to rate a chat
aliases: enable thumbs up and down rating
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Live chat** > **Widget**.
2. Select **Features**.
3. Switch on **Satisfaction rating**.
4. Edit the rating question if you wish.
5. Select **Save**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Connect a support email address
aliases: link a mailbox to Harbour Desk
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email**.
2. Select **Add email address**.
3. Enter the address, for example support@yourcompany.com.
4. Choose the **Default team** to receive tickets.
5. Select **Save**, then follow the forwarding instructions shown.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Forward emails to Harbour Desk
aliases: forward support emails to the helpdesk address
body:
1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email** and open your address.
2. Copy the **Forwarding address**.
3. In your email provider's settings, create a forwarding rule to that address.
4. Return to Desk and select **Send test email**.

The status changes to **Connected** once the test email arrives.

title: Verify your sending domain
body:
Verifying your domain helps customers receive your replies in their inbox.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email** > **Domains**.
2. Select **Add domain** and enter your domain name.
3. Copy the DNS records shown.
4. Add them with your domain provider.
5. Select **Verify**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Set the default email signature for a channel
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email** and open the address.
2. Select **Signature**.
3. Edit the text in the editor. Use **{{agent.name}}** to include the agent's name.
4. Select **Save**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Turn on the automatic acknowledgement email
aliases: send a confirmation when a ticket is received
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email** > **Auto-replies**.
2. Switch on **Acknowledge new tickets**.
3. Edit the **Subject** and message.
4. Select **Save**.

The message is sent once, when a customer first emails you. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Add a CC recipient to a ticket
aliases: copy someone in on an email
include another person in a reply
add another contact to a conversation
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Open the ticket in your **Inbox**.
2. Select **Reply**.
3. Select **CC** above the editor.
4. Enter the email address.
5. Select **Send**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Update a requester's email address
aliases: edit contact email on a ticket
body:
Changing the email updates the customer's record and all of their tickets.

1. Go to **Customers**.
2. Search for the customer and open their record.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Replace the address in the **Email** field.
5. Select **Save**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Update a customer's phone number
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Customers**.
2. Search for the customer and open their record.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Enter the new number in **Phone**.
5. Select **Save**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Add a customer
aliases: add a client to the helpdesk
body:
Customers are usually created automatically when they email you. You can also add one yourself.

1. Go to **Customers**.
2. Select **New customer**.
3. Enter the **Name** and **Email**. Phone and **Organisation** are optional.
4. Select **Save**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Delete a customer record
aliases: delete a requester and their data
get rid of a client record
body:
Deleting a customer also removes their tickets after 30 days. This cannot be undone once that period has passed.

1. Go to **Customers**.
2. Open the customer's record.
3. Select **More actions** > **Delete customer**.
4. Type **DELETE** to confirm.
5. Select **Delete**.

Changes are saved straight away.

title: Block an email sender
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Open a ticket from the sender.
2. Select **More actions** > **Block sender**.
3. Choose **This address** or **Entire domain**.
4. Select **Block**.

Future emails from them are discarded and no tickets are created. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Restore a ticket from spam
aliases: rescue a real email from spam
move ticket out of spam folder
recover a ticket wrongly marked as spam
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Inbox** > **Spam**.
2. Open the ticket.
3. Select **Not spam**.
4. Select **Confirm**.

The ticket returns to the **New** view and the sender is allowed to email you again. Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Merge duplicate tickets
body:
Merging moves all messages into one ticket and closes the other.

1. Open the ticket you want to close.
2. Select **More actions** > **Merge**.
3. Search for the ticket to keep.
4. Select **Merge tickets**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Route emails to a team by address
aliases: send emails from sales@ to a certain team
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Admin** > **Channels** > **Email** > **Routing**.
2. Select **New rule**.
3. Under **If**, choose **Recipient address** is the address you want.
4. Under **Then**, choose **Assign to team** and pick the team.
5. Select **Save rule**.

title: Add a private note to a ticket
aliases: leave an internal comment on a ticket
write a note only agents see
body:
Private notes are never sent to the customer.

1. Open the ticket in your **Inbox**.
2. Select **Add note** above the reply box.
3. Type your note. Use @ to mention a colleague.
4. Select **Save note**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Change a ticket's status
body:
The statuses are **Open**, **Pending**, **On hold**, **Solved** and **Closed**.

1. Open the ticket in your **Inbox**.
2. Select the **Status** list in the right panel.
3. Choose the new status.
4. Select **Save**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: View the reports dashboard
aliases: check how the team is doing
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Select **Reports** in the left menu.
2. Open **Overview**.
3. Use the **Date range** list at the top to choose a period.
4. Scroll to see ticket volume, response times and satisfaction.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Create a custom report
aliases: make a new report with chosen metrics
set up a custom analytics report
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Custom reports**.
2. Select **New report**.
3. Choose a **Metric**, such as **Tickets created**, and a **Group by** option.
4. Add any filters.
5. Select **Save report** and give it a name.

title: Duplicate a report
aliases: make a version of an existing report
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Custom reports**.
2. Select the **More** menu on the report.
3. Select **Duplicate**.
4. Rename the copy and adjust its filters.
5. Select **Save report**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Delete a custom report
aliases: get rid of a saved report
body:
Deleting a report also removes any schedules attached to it.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Custom reports**.
2. Select the **More** menu on the report.
3. Select **Delete**.
4. Select **Confirm**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this. If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Export a report to CSV
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Reports** and open the report.
2. Set the **Date range** and any filters.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV** and select **Download**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role. Changes are saved straight away.

title: Export tickets to CSV
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Inbox** and open a view, or use **Search** to find the tickets you need.
2. Select **Export**.
3. Choose the fields to include.
4. Select **Export to CSV**.

We will email you a download link when the file is ready.

title: Schedule a report by email
aliases: email me this report every Monday
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Reports** and open the report.
2. Select **Schedule**.
3. Choose how often it is sent: **Daily**, **Weekly** or **Monthly**.
4. Enter the recipients' email addresses.
5. Select **Save schedule**.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Share a report with a colleague
aliases: give someone access to a report
let a supervisor see my report
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Reports** and open the report.
2. Select **Share**.
3. Enter the name of an agent or team.
4. Choose **Can view** or **Can edit**.
5. Select **Share**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: Change the date range of a report
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Open any report in **Reports**.
2. Select the **Date range** list at the top.
3. Choose a preset, such as **Last 30 days**, or select **Custom**.
4. Select **Apply**.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

title: Filter a report by team
aliases: only see my team in reports
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Open any report in **Reports**.
2. Select **Filters** > **Team**.
3. Tick one or more teams.
4. Select **Apply**.

Changes are saved straight away. The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: View agent performance
aliases: how many tickets did each agent solve
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Agents**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Review tickets solved, average first response time and satisfaction for each agent.
4. Select an agent's name for a detailed breakdown.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: View customer satisfaction results
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Satisfaction**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. See the overall score and the split of **Good** and **Bad** ratings.
4. Select **Comments** to read what customers wrote.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: View SLA compliance
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Reports** > **SLAs**.
2. Choose a policy from the **SLA policy** list.
3. Review the percentage of tickets that met first response and resolution targets.
4. Select a bar in the chart to list the breached tickets.

title: View first response time
body:
If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Response times**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Select **Group by** > **Channel**, **Team** or **Agent**.
4. Read the average and median times in the table.

Times are shown in business hours if the ticket uses a schedule.

title: See ticket volume by channel
aliases: how many tickets come from email vs chat
body:
Changes are saved straight away.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Overview**.
2. Open the **Tickets created** chart.
3. Select **Group by** > **Channel**.
4. Hover over a bar to see the count for each channel.

The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

title: Add a chart to your dashboard
aliases: pin a report to the overview
put a chart on my dashboard
show a report on the home page
body:
The action is recorded in the audit log under **Admin** > **Audit log**.

1. Open a report in **Reports**.
2. Select **Add to dashboard**.
3. Choose the dashboard and a chart type such as **Bar** or **Line**.
4. Select **Add**.

Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

title: See which knowledge base articles are viewed most
body:
Your administrator controls who has permission to do this.

1. Go to **Reports** > **Knowledge base**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Sort the table by **Views**.
4. Select an article title to see searches that led to it.

If you can't see this option, ask an admin to check your role.
